steps: Cook the onion slowly in half the butter for 25 minutes and add the white wine vinegar.
Fry the sage in the rest of the butter, then sear the calf's liver for 1 minute per side.
Serve with the onions and soft polenta.

recipes.title: Entrecôte bordelaise
recipes.why: A red wine and marrow sauce is the classic for a structured, oaked red.
steps: Reduce the red wine with the shallot and thyme, add the beef stock and reduce, then whisk in the butter and diced bone marrow.
Grill the entrecote to medium-rare.
Serve with the sauce.

recipes.title: Lamb with flageolet beans and rosemary
recipes.why: Lamb and herbs suit a classic, oaked red blend.
steps: Roast the lamb rump with the rosemary, garlic and olive oil at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Warm the flageolet beans with the red wine and pan juices.
Slice the lamb and serve on the beans.

recipes.title: Beef Wellington with smoked garlic duxelles
recipes.why: Rich pastry, mushroom and beef want a structured, oaked red.
steps: Sear the beef fillet and brush with the dijon mustard.
Cook the chestnut mushrooms with the thyme and smoked garlic until dry, spread on the prosciutto and wrap the beef.
Wrap in puff pastry, brush with the eggs and bake at 200 °C for 35–40 minutes.

recipes.title: Smoked lamb rump with aubergine and miso
recipes.why: Smoke and savoury miso suit an oaked, structured red.
steps: Halve the aubergines, score and brush with the white miso, honey and sesame oil, then roast at 200 °C for 30 minutes.
Season the lamb rump with the smoked salt and grill for 12 minutes, turning.
Rest, slice and serve with the aubergine.

recipes.title: Venison stew with chestnuts and cocoa
recipes.why: Cocoa and chestnut echo the toast of an oaked red.
steps: Brown the venison shoulder, add the onion, red wine and thyme and braise for 2 hours.
Add the chestnuts and cocoa powder and cook for 20 minutes more.

recipes.title: Lamb kleftiko with oregano and lemon
recipes.why: Slow-baked lamb with herbs suits a ripe, fruity red.
steps: Rub the lamb shoulder with the dried oregano, garlic, lemon juice and olive oil.
Wrap with the potatoes in baking paper and foil and bake at 160 °C for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Beef ragù lasagne with nutmeg
recipes.why: Rich layers of meat and béchamel suit a ripe, fruity Italian red.
steps: Brown the beef mince and simmer with the passata for 1 hour.
Make a béchamel with the butter, plain flour, milk and nutmeg.
Layer with the lasagne sheets, top with parmesan and bake at 180 °C for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Lamb with apricots and ras el hanout
recipes.why: Warm spice and dried fruit suit a fruity, spicy red.
steps: Brown the lamb shoulder and onion with the ras el hanout.
Add water and simmer for 1½ hours, then add the dried apricots and chickpeas for 30 minutes.
Finish with coriander leaves.

recipes.title: Lamb shawarma with allspice and pickled turnip
recipes.why: Allspice and roasted lamb need a red with ripe fruit and spice.
steps: Toss the lamb leg with the allspice, cumin seeds and garlic and roast at 220 °C for 20 minutes.
Serve in the flatbread with tahini and pickled turnips.

recipes.title: Kofte with spiced tomato and sumac onions
recipes.why: Spiced beef and tomato suit a fruity red with peppery spice.
steps: Mix the beef mince with the cumin seeds and aleppo pepper and shape onto skewers.
Grill for 8 minutes and serve with the warm tomatoes, red onion with sumac and flatbread.

recipes.title: Sweet and sour Sicilian beef with cocoa
recipes.why: Sweet-sour sauce and ripe fruit match a soft, fruity red.
steps: Brown the beef chuck and onion, add the red wine and braise for 2 hours.
Stir in the red wine vinegar, raisins and cocoa powder and cook for 20 minutes.
Scatter with pine nuts.

recipes.title: Pork and fennel sausage with grapes
recipes.why: Roasted grapes and fennel pick up the ripe fruit of a soft red.
steps: Toss the pork sausages, red grapes and red onion with the fennel seeds and olive oil.
Roast at 200 °C for 30 minutes and finish with the balsamic vinegar.

recipes.title: Glazed beef cheeks with hoisin and five spice
recipes.why: A sweet, spiced glaze suits a rich red with a touch of sweetness.
steps: Brown the beef cheeks, add the hoisin sauce, light soy sauce, fresh ginger, five spice and water and braise for 3 hours.
Reduce the sauce to a glaze and serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Korean BBQ short ribs with ginger and pear
recipes.why: Sweet soy marinade and char suit a ripe red with a hint of sweetness.
steps: Marinate the beef short ribs with the light soy sauce, pear, light brown sugar, sesame oil, gochujang, fresh ginger and garlic overnight.
Grill over high heat for 2–3 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Venison sausages with red cabbage and juniper
recipes.why: Sweet-sour cabbage and juniper suit a light, high-acid red.
steps: Braise the red cabbage with the apple, red wine vinegar, juniper berries and light brown sugar for 1 hour.
Fry the venison sausages and serve on the cabbage.

recipes.title: Pigeon with blackberries and cocoa
recipes.why: Gamey pigeon and dark fruit suit an oaked, fruit-driven red.
steps: Sear the pigeon in the butter and roast at 220 °C for 8 minutes. Rest.
Deglaze with the red wine, add the blackberries and reduce.
Carve and serve with the sauce and cocoa nibs.

recipes.title: Rabbit with mustard and tarragon
recipes.why: Mild rabbit and mustard cream suit a supple, fresh red.
steps: Brown the rabbit, add the shallot and dry white wine and braise for 50 minutes.
Stir in the dijon mustard, double cream and tarragon.

recipes.title: Osso buco with gremolata and fennel pollen
recipes.why: Tomato-braised veal and citrus gremolata suit a high-acid red.
steps: Brown the veal shanks, add the onion, dry white wine and tomatoes and braise for 2 hours.
Chop the lemon zest, parsley, garlic and anchovies into a gremolata.
Serve the shanks topped with the gremolata and a dusting of fennel pollen.

recipes.title: Wild boar pappardelle with tomato and rosemary
recipes.why: Gamey boar and tomato want a high-acid, savoury red.
steps: Brown the wild boar with the onion and rosemary, add the red wine and tomatoes and braise for 3 hours.
Shred and toss with the cooked pappardelle.

recipes.title: Roast chicken with tarragon butter
recipes.why: Buttery roast chicken and tarragon suit a round, oaked white.
steps: Mash the butter with the tarragon and push it under the skin of the whole chicken. Put the lemon and garlic inside.
Roast on the potatoes at 200 °C for 75–80 minutes.
Rest for 10 minutes and carve with the pan juices.

recipes.title: Chicken fricassée with morels and cream
recipes.why: Morels and cream need a rich, oaked white with good acidity.
steps: Brown the chicken thighs in the butter, add the shallot and dry white wine and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the dried morels with a little of their soaking liquid and the double cream and simmer for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Buttermilk fried chicken with fennel pollen salt
recipes.why: Crisp fried chicken is a natural partner for a dry sparkling.
steps: Soak the chicken thighs in the buttermilk overnight.
Dredge in the seasoned plain flour and fry in the sunflower oil at 170 °C for 8–10 minutes.
Sprinkle with the fennel pollen mixed with flaky salt.

recipes.title: Chicken with saffron, preserved lemon and green olives
recipes.why: Fragrant saffron and preserved lemon suit a round, aromatic white.
steps: Brown the chicken thighs in the olive oil, add the onion, saffron and ground ginger and 300 ml water.
Simmer for 35 minutes, add the preserved lemon and green olives and cook for 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Chicken with apricots, cinnamon and rose
recipes.why: Rose and apricot reach the perfume and spice of a white.
steps: Brown the chicken thighs with the onion and cinnamon, add the dried apricots, saffron and 300 ml water and simmer for 35 minutes.
Stir in the rose water and serve with basmati rice.

recipes.title: Thai green chicken curry with lime leaf
recipes.why: Green curry's herbs and coconut suit an aromatic, off-dry white.
steps: Fry the green curry paste, add the coconut milk and kaffir lime leaves and simmer.
Add the chicken thighs and cook for 10 minutes. Season with the fish sauce and palm sugar.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Butter chicken with fenugreek
recipes.why: Creamy, gently spiced sauce suits a perfumed white.
steps: Marinate the chicken thighs in the greek yoghurt and garam masala and grill until charred.
Simmer the tomatoes with the butter, add the double cream and dried fenugreek leaves.
Add the chicken and serve with basmati rice.

recipes.title: Sticky chicken wings with tamarind and chilli
recipes.why: Sweet-sour tamarind and chilli heat want an off-dry white.
steps: Roast the chicken wings at 220 °C for 30 minutes.
Simmer the tamarind paste, palm sugar, fish sauce and red chilli until syrupy.
Toss the wings in the glaze and roast for 10 minutes more. Squeeze over the lime.

recipes.title: Teriyaki chicken with pickled ginger
recipes.why: Sweet soy glaze and sharp ginger suit an off-dry, high-acid white.
steps: Sear the chicken thighs skin-side down until crisp.
Add the light soy sauce, mirin and honey and reduce to a glaze.
Slice and serve with jasmine rice, pickled ginger and spring onions.

recipes.title: Poached chicken with watercress sauce
recipes.why: Clean poached chicken and peppery watercress suit a lean, crisp white.
steps: Poach the chicken breast in the chicken stock for 15 minutes.
Blend the watercress with the creme fraiche, lemon juice and a ladle of stock.
Serve sliced with the potatoes and watercress sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken paillard with verjuice and capers
recipes.why: Verjuice's soft acidity wants a lean, high-acid white.
steps: Sear the chicken breast in half the butter for 2 minutes per side.
Add the verjuice and capers, reduce and whisk in the rest of the butter.
Serve with rocket and parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken souvlaki with sumac and tzatziki
recipes.why: Grilled chicken and tangy sumac suit a fresh, fruity rosé.
steps: Marinate the chicken thighs with the sumac, lemon juice and garlic, thread onto skewers and grill.
Mix the greek yoghurt and cucumber into tzatziki.
Serve in the flatbread with the tzatziki.

recipes.title: Provençal chicken with olives, fennel and pastis
recipes.why: Fennel, olive and pastis are a natural match for a rosé.
steps: Brown the chicken thighs in the olive oil, add the fennel and garlic, then the pastis.
Add the tomatoes and black olives and simmer for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Roast chicken with sour cherries and pistachio
recipes.why: Sour cherries pull chicken toward a light, juicy red.
steps: Roast the chicken thighs and red onion with the olive oil at 210 °C for 35 minutes.
Add the sour cherries and honey and roast for 10 minutes more.
Scatter with pistachios.

recipes.title: Coq au vin with smoked garlic
recipes.why: Wine-braised chicken and mushrooms are the classic for a light, earthy red.
steps: Brown the chicken legs and pancetta, add the shallot, smoked garlic, thyme and red wine and braise for 1 hour.
Add the chestnut mushrooms and cook for 20 minutes more.

recipes.title: Guinea fowl with prunes and Armagnac
recipes.why: Prunes and gamey fowl suit a light, earthy red.
steps: Soak the prunes in the armagnac.
Brown the guinea fowl in the butter and roast at 190 °C for 50 minutes with the thyme.
Add the prunes, armagnac and chicken stock to the tray for the last 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Duck breast with figs and balsamic
recipes.why: Ripe figs and balsamic suit an oaked, fruit-driven red.
steps: Cook the duck breasts skin-side down in a cold pan for 10 minutes, turn for 3 minutes and rest.
Caramelise the fresh figs in the duck fat with the thyme, then add the balsamic vinegar and honey.
Slice the duck and serve with the figs.

recipes.title: Turkey meatballs with cranberry and sage
recipes.why: Tart cranberries and sage suit a supple, fresh red.
steps: Mix the turkey mince, breadcrumbs, eggs and sage and roll into balls. Brown in the olive oil.
Add the cranberries, caster sugar and 100 ml water and simmer for 10 minutes until the berries burst.

recipes.title: Duck ragù with orange and cloves
recipes.why: Rich duck and warm spice suit a medium red with fresh acidity.
steps: Brown the duck legs, add the onion, red wine, tomatoes, orange and cloves and braise for 2 hours.
Shred the meat and toss with the cooked pappardelle.

recipes.title: Chicken cacciatore with rosemary and olives
recipes.why: Tomato, rosemary and olives want a high-acid red.
steps: Brown the chicken thighs in the olive oil, add the garlic, rosemary and red wine.
Add the tomatoes and black olives and simmer for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken diavola with chilli and fennel
recipes.why: Chilli and fennel seed pick up the spice of a fresh red.
steps: Rub the poussin with the chilli flakes, fennel seeds, garlic, lemon juice and olive oil.
Grill under a weight for 20–25 minutes per side until cooked through.

recipes.title: Duck with allspice and plums
recipes.why: Allspice and plums meet the spice and ripe fruit of a southern red.
steps: Rub the duck breasts with the allspice and cook skin-side down for 10 minutes, then turn and rest.
Cook the plums in the fat with the red wine and honey until soft.
Slice and serve.

recipes.title: Duck with blackcurrant and lavender
recipes.why: Lavender and blackcurrant echo a perfumed, full-bodied red.
steps: Cook the duck breasts skin-side down for 10 minutes, turn for 3 minutes and rest.
Simmer the blackcurrants with the red wine, honey and dried lavender for 5 minutes.
Slice and serve with the sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken with orange blossom, almonds and couscous
recipes.why: Orange blossom and almond suit a dry, floral white.
steps: Roast the chicken thighs with the orange juice, honey and cinnamon at 210 °C for 35 minutes.
Stir the orange blossom water into the pan juices.
Serve over couscous with flaked almonds.

recipes.title: Chicken with Riesling, tarragon and grapes
recipes.why: White wine in the sauce and fresh grapes make an obvious match for an aromatic white.
steps: Brown the chicken thighs in the butter, add the shallot and dry white wine and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the white grapes, double cream and tarragon and cook for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken escabeche with saffron and sherry vinegar
recipes.why: Vinegar-cured chicken needs a crisp, fruity white.
steps: Brown the chicken thighs, then add the carrots, onion, bay leaves, saffron, olive oil and sherry vinegar.
Simmer for 20 minutes and leave to cool in the liquid. Serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Chicken schnitzel with horseradish potato salad
recipes.why: Crisp schnitzel and horseradish suit a peppery white.
steps: Coat the chicken breast in plain flour, eggs and breadcrumbs and fry in the sunflower oil.
Dress the warm boiled potatoes with the white wine vinegar and horseradish.
Serve together.

recipes.title: Chicken and leek pie with nutmeg
recipes.why: A creamy pie with puff pastry suits a round, oaked white.
steps: Brown the chicken thighs with the leeks, stir in the plain flour, then the chicken stock, double cream and nutmeg.
Pour into a pie dish, cover with the puff pastry and bake at 200 °C for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Smoked chicken with sweetcorn and chipotle butter
recipes.why: Smoky chicken and sweet corn suit a white with some oak.
steps: Season the chicken thighs with smoked salt and grill.
Grill the sweetcorn cobs.
Mash the butter with the chipotle in adobo and lime and melt over everything.

recipes.title: Chicken korma with cardamom
recipes.why: Creamy, mildly spiced korma suits a round, aromatic white.
steps: Soften the onion with the cardamom and cinnamon, add the chicken thighs and brown.
Add the ground almonds, greek yoghurt and 200 ml water and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with basmati rice.

recipes.title: Kung pao chicken with Sichuan pepper
recipes.why: Numbing pepper and sweet-sour sauce want an off-dry white.
steps: Stir-fry the chicken thighs until browned, add the dried chillies and sichuan peppercorns.
Add the light soy sauce, rice vinegar and caster sugar and toss with the roasted peanuts.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Chicken fesenjan with pomegranate and walnut
recipes.why: Sweet-sour pomegranate and walnut suit a juicy, light red.
steps: Toast the ground walnuts, then simmer with the pomegranate molasses, onion, cinnamon and 500 ml water for 30 minutes.
Add the chicken thighs and cook for 30 minutes more.
Serve with basmati rice.

recipes.title: Chicken thighs with harissa and dates
recipes.why: Harissa and sweet dates pull chicken toward a soft, fruity red.
steps: Rub the chicken thighs with the harissa and olive oil.
Roast with the red onion and medjool dates at 210 °C for 35–40 minutes.
Squeeze over the lemon.

recipes.title: Roast quail with lychee and ginger
recipes.why: Lychee and ginger echo the perfume of a dry white.
steps: Brush the quail with the honey, light soy sauce and fresh ginger and roast at 220 °C for 15 minutes.
Add the lychees for the last 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken biryani with rose water and saffron
recipes.why: Rose, saffron and warm spice suit an aromatic white.
steps: Marinate the chicken thighs in the greek yoghurt and garam masala and cook until tender.
Layer with the par-cooked basmati rice, saffron and rose water, cover tightly and bake at 170 °C for 30 minutes.
Serve topped with the crisp onion.

recipes.title: Chicken paella with saffron and peppers
recipes.why: Saffron and sweet peppers are a classic for a rosé.
steps: Brown the chicken thighs and red pepper in the olive oil, add the smoked paprika and paella rice.
Add the chicken stock and saffron and simmer without stirring for 20 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Guinea fowl with Savoy cabbage and juniper
recipes.why: Juniper and cabbage suit a supple red with fresh acidity.
steps: Roast the guinea fowl at 190 °C for 50 minutes.
Fry the pancetta, add the savoy cabbage, juniper berries and chicken stock and braise for 15 minutes.
Carve and serve on the cabbage.

recipes.title: Duck legs with figs and red wine
recipes.why: Dried figs and duck suit a ripe, fruity red.
steps: Brown the duck legs, add the onion, red wine, dried figs and thyme and braise for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Pheasant with chestnuts and cloves
recipes.why: Gamey pheasant and warm spice suit a full, spicy red.
steps: Brown the pheasant in the butter and roast at 200 °C for 35 minutes.
Fry the pancetta and chestnuts with the cloves and red wine.
Serve the carved pheasant with the chestnuts.

recipes.title: Roast goose with red cabbage and caraway
recipes.why: Fatty goose needs a firm, tannic red; caraway lifts the cabbage.
steps: Roast the goose at 180 °C for 3 hours, pouring off the fat.
Braise the red cabbage with the apples, caraway seeds and red wine vinegar for 1 hour.
Carve the goose and serve with the cabbage.

recipes.title: Duck breast with celeriac and coffee jus
recipes.why: Coffee in the jus echoes the toast of a structured red.
steps: Simmer the celeriac in the milk and blend with the butter.
Reduce the beef stock with the ground coffee.
Cook the duck breasts skin-side down for 10 minutes, turn for 3 and rest. Serve with the purée and jus.

recipes.title: Grilled poussin with chimichurri rojo
recipes.why: Smoky paprika chimichurri suits a supple, fresh red.
steps: Mix the smoked paprika, red wine vinegar, garlic, dried oregano and olive oil.
Grill the poussin for 20 minutes per side, brushing with half the sauce.
Serve with the rest of the chimichurri.

recipes.title: Pork belly with apple and star anise glaze
recipes.why: A sweet-spiced glaze and rich pork want an off-dry white.
steps: Roast the pork belly at 160 °C for 2 hours, then at 230 °C for 20 minutes to crackle.
Simmer the apples with the star anise, honey and cider vinegar until soft and glossy.
Serve the pork with the apples.

recipes.title: Char siu pork with five spice
recipes.why: Sweet, spiced roast pork suits an off-dry, aromatic white.
steps: Marinate the pork shoulder with the hoisin sauce, honey, light soy sauce and five spice overnight.
Roast at 200 °C for 40 minutes, basting.
Slice and serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Pork and lychee stir-fry with ginger
recipes.why: Lychee and ginger suit the perfume of an aromatic white.
steps: Stir-fry the pork tenderloin with the fresh ginger.
Add the lychees and light soy sauce and toss with the spring onions.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Schweinsbraten with caraway and dark beer
recipes.why: Caraway and crisp pork crackling suit a peppery white.
steps: Rub the pork shoulder with the caraway seeds, garlic and salt.
Roast on the onion with the dark beer at 180 °C for 2½ hours, raising to 230 °C at the end to crackle.

recipes.title: Pork schnitzel with lemon and white pepper
recipes.why: Crisp pork and white pepper suit a peppery Austrian white.
steps: Season the pork loin with the white pepper, coat in plain flour, eggs and breadcrumbs.
Fry in the sunflower oil until golden and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Pork tenderloin with apples, Calvados and sage
recipes.why: Apple and cream suit a round, fresh white.
steps: Sear the pork tenderloin in the butter with the sage and roast at 200 °C for 12 minutes.
Fry the apples in the pan, flame with the calvados and add the double cream.
Slice the pork and serve with the sauce.

recipes.title: Pork chop with smoked butter and apple
recipes.why: Smoky butter and pork suit a toasty, oaked white.
steps: Sear the pork chops for 4–5 minutes per side.
Add the apples and thyme and baste with the smoked butter.

recipes.title: Pork secreto with orange and thyme
recipes.why: Juicy Iberian pork and orange suit a fruity rosé.
steps: Marinate the pork secreto with the orange, thyme, garlic and olive oil.
Grill over high heat for 3–4 minutes per side and sprinkle with flaky salt.

recipes.title: Porchetta with fennel pollen and chilli
recipes.why: Fennel and chilli are the classic for a fresh, spicy red.
steps: Spread the inside of the pork belly with the fennel pollen, chilli flakes, garlic, rosemary and lemon zest. Roll and tie.
Roast at 160 °C for 2½ hours, then at 230 °C for 20 minutes to crackle.

recipes.title: Pork chops pizzaiola with fennel seed
recipes.why: Tomato and oregano want a high-acid Italian red.
steps: Sear the pork chops in the olive oil.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, dried oregano and fennel seeds and simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pork with prunes and cream
recipes.why: Prunes and pork suit a medium red with fresh fruit.
steps: Soak the prunes in the dry white wine.
Sear the pork tenderloin in the butter and roast for 12 minutes.
Soften the shallot, add the prunes, wine and double cream and reduce. Serve with the sliced pork.

recipes.title: Roast pork loin with cherries and thyme
recipes.why: Sour cherries lift pork toward a bright red.
steps: Roast the pork loin with the thyme at 190 °C for 70 minutes.
Simmer the sour cherries with the red wine and honey.
Slice and serve with the cherries.

recipes.title: Pork ribs with plum and star anise
recipes.why: Plum and star anise suit a ripe, fruit-forward red.
steps: Roast the pork ribs covered at 160 °C for 2 hours.
Simmer the plums with the star anise, light soy sauce, honey and fresh ginger to a glaze.
Brush over the ribs and roast uncovered at 220 °C for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pork involtini with raisins and pine nuts
recipes.why: Sweet raisins and pork suit a soft, fruity Sicilian red.
steps: Mix the breadcrumbs, raisins, pine nuts and pecorino and spread over the pork loin escalopes. Roll and secure.
Brown and simmer in the passata for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pulled pork with chipotle and coffee
recipes.why: Smoky chipotle and coffee suit a spicy, oaked red.
steps: Rub the pork shoulder with the ground coffee, light brown sugar and chipotle in adobo.
Cook covered at 140 °C for 6 hours.
Shred, toss with the cider vinegar and juices and serve in the burger buns.

recipes.title: BBQ pork ribs with coffee and molasses glaze
recipes.why: Coffee, molasses and smoke match a ripe, oaked red.
steps: Rub the pork ribs with the smoked paprika and light brown sugar and cook low at 140 °C for 2½ hours.
Mix the molasses, ground coffee and cider vinegar, brush over and grill until sticky.

recipes.title: Pork belly with dates and cinnamon
recipes.why: Sweet dates and warm spice match a jammy, low-acid red.
steps: Brown the pork belly, add the onion, cinnamon and water and braise for 2 hours.
Add the medjool dates and honey and reduce to a glaze.

recipes.title: Pork and clams with coriander seed
recipes.why: Pork and briny clams want a lean, crisp white.
steps: Marinate the pork shoulder with the dry white wine, garlic and coriander seeds for 2 hours.
Brown the pork, add the marinade and clams and cover until the clams open.
Toss with the potatoes and coriander leaves.

recipes.title: Toulouse sausages with lentils and quatre épices
recipes.why: Spiced sausage and lentils suit a supple red with fresh acidity.
steps: Brown the pork sausages, add the onion, carrot, puy lentils, quatre epices, red wine and water.
Simmer for 30 minutes until the lentils are tender.

recipes.title: Feijoada with cloves and orange
recipes.why: Smoky meats and black beans need a full, spicy red.
steps: Simmer the black beans with the pork ribs, chorizo, smoked ham, onion and cloves for 3 hours.
Serve with orange wedges.

recipes.title: Pork carnitas with orange and cumin
recipes.why: Crisp spiced pork and orange suit a fruity, spicy red.
steps: Simmer the pork shoulder with the orange, cumin seeds, garlic and water for 2½ hours.
Shred and fry in its own fat until crisp.
Serve in the corn tortillas with lime.

recipes.title: Banh mi with lemongrass pork
recipes.why: Lemongrass, chilli and pickles suit an off-dry white.
steps: Mix the pork mince with the lemongrass and fish sauce and grill as small patties.
Fill the baguette with the pork, carrot, cucumber, coriander leaves and red chilli.

recipes.title: Tonkatsu with cabbage and yuzu
recipes.why: Crisp, fried pork and citrus are made for a dry sparkling.
steps: Coat the pork loin in eggs and panko and fry in the sunflower oil at 170 °C.
Dress the white cabbage with the yuzu juice.
Slice the pork and serve with the cabbage.

recipes.title: Pork loin with apricot and thyme stuffing
recipes.why: Apricot and herbs suit a round, oaked white.
steps: Soften the onion in the butter and mix with the dried apricots, breadcrumbs and thyme.
Stuff and roll the pork loin and roast at 190 °C for 75 minutes.

recipes.title: Pasta alla Norma with smoked ricotta
recipes.why: Tomato and aubergine need a high-acid red; smoked ricotta adds depth.
steps: Fry the aubergines in the olive oil until golden.
Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic for 15 minutes, add the aubergines and basil.
Toss with the cooked rigatoni and grate the smoked ricotta on top.

recipes.title: Tomato and burrata pizza with wild fennel
recipes.why: Tomato and fennel seed suit a bright, savoury red.
steps: Stretch the pizza dough, spread with the passata and bake at the highest oven setting for 8–10 minutes.
Tear the burrata over, scatter with the fennel seeds and basil and drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.title: Polenta with porcini ragù and black pepper
recipes.why: Porcini, tomato and pepper suit a spicy, fresh red.
steps: Fry the chestnut mushrooms and garlic in the olive oil, add the dried porcini and tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the polenta and beat in the parmesan.
Serve the ragù on the polenta with plenty of black pepper.

recipes.title: Stuffed peppers with rice, pine nuts and allspice
recipes.why: Allspice and tomato suit a spicy, high-acid red.
steps: Mix the basmati rice with the pine nuts, currants, allspice and half the tomatoes.
Fill the red pepper and set in a dish on the rest of the tomatoes.
Drizzle with olive oil and bake at 190 °C for 45 minutes. Finish with dill.

recipes.title: Mushroom risotto with smoked butter
recipes.why: Creamy rice and smoky butter suit a toasty, oaked white.
steps: Fry the chestnut mushrooms and set aside. Soften the shallot, add the arborio rice and dry white wine.
Add the vegetable stock a ladle at a time for 18 minutes, then the mushrooms.
Beat in the smoked butter and parmesan.

recipes.title: Celeriac and Comté gratin with mace
recipes.why: A rich cheese gratin needs a round, oaked white.
steps: Warm the double cream with the garlic and ground mace.
Layer the celeriac with the comte and pour over the cream.
Bake at 170 °C for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Asparagus and pea risotto with lemon balm
recipes.why: Green spring flavours and lemon balm suit a round, fresh white.
steps: Toast the arborio rice in half the butter and add the vegetable stock a ladle at a time.
Add the green asparagus and peas for the last 5 minutes.
Beat in the rest of the butter, the parmesan and the lemon balm.

recipes.title: Sweet potato and chickpea curry with cardamom
recipes.why: Coconut, cardamom and sweet potato suit a perfumed white.
steps: Soften the onion with the cardamom and garam masala, add the sweet potato, chickpeas and coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and serve with basmati rice.

recipes.title: Thai red curry with tofu and lychee
recipes.why: Lychee and curry spice reach the perfume of an aromatic white.
steps: Fry the red curry paste, add the coconut milk and simmer.
Add the tofu, green beans and lychees and cook for 8 minutes.
Serve with jasmine rice and thai basil.

recipes.title: Pad thai with tofu and tamarind
recipes.why: Sweet-sour tamarind sauce wants an off-dry white.
steps: Stir-fry the tofu, push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the soaked rice noodles, tamarind paste, palm sugar and light soy sauce and toss.
Serve with bean sprouts, roasted peanuts and lime.

recipes.title: Sichuan fish-fragrant aubergine
recipes.why: Sweet, sour and numbing heat suit an off-dry white.
steps: Fry the aubergines in the sunflower oil until soft.
Add the garlic, fresh ginger and sichuan peppercorns, then the rice vinegar, caster sugar and light soy sauce.
Toss and serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Vegetable tempura with yuzu kosho mayonnaise
recipes.why: Light, crisp tempura is made for a dry sparkling.
steps: Slice the courgette, sweet potato and shiitake mushrooms.
Dip in a batter of plain flour and sparkling water and fry in the sunflower oil at 180 °C.
Serve with the mayonnaise mixed with the yuzu kosho.

recipes.title: Spinach and ricotta gnudi with watercress butter
recipes.why: Delicate gnudi and peppery watercress suit a lean, crisp white.
steps: Mix the ricotta, spinach, parmesan and plain flour and roll into balls.
Poach for 3–4 minutes until they float.
Melt the butter with the watercress and spoon over.

recipes.title: Käsespätzle with crispy onions and caraway
recipes.why: Cheesy noodles and caraway suit a peppery Austrian white.
steps: Beat the plain flour, eggs and milk into a sticky batter and press through a spätzle maker into boiling water.
Layer with the emmental and caraway seeds.
Fry the onion in the butter until crisp and pile on top.

recipes.title: Ratatouille with herbes de Provence
recipes.why: Sun-ripe vegetables and herbs are a natural for a rosé.
steps: Fry the onion, then the aubergines, courgette and red pepper separately in the olive oil until golden.
Combine with the tomatoes and herbes de provence and simmer gently for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Shakshuka with feta and cumin
recipes.why: Eggs in spiced tomato suit a fresh, fruity rosé.
steps: Soften the onion and red pepper in the olive oil with the cumin seeds, add the tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 6 minutes.
Crumble the feta on top.

recipes.title: Black bean chilli with chipotle and cocoa
recipes.why: Smoky chilli and cocoa suit a fruity, spicy red.
steps: Soften the onion with the cumin seeds, add the chipotle in adobo, tomatoes and black beans and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the cocoa powder and serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Beetroot risotto with goat's cheese and horseradish
recipes.why: Earthy beetroot suits a light red; horseradish adds bite.
steps: Toast the arborio rice in the butter, add the red wine, then the vegetable stock a ladle at a time.
Stir in the beetroot for the last 5 minutes.
Serve topped with goat's cheese and grated horseradish.

recipes.title: Mushroom bourguignon with cloves
recipes.why: Wine-braised mushrooms are made for a light, earthy red.
steps: Brown the chestnut mushrooms and shallot, add the carrots, tomato paste, red wine, cloves and thyme and simmer for 35 minutes.
Serve over mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Wild mushroom and chestnut pie with smoked salt
recipes.why: Earthy mushrooms and smoke suit an oaked red.
steps: Fry the wild mushrooms with the shallot and thyme, add the chestnuts, double cream and smoked salt.
Spoon into a pie dish, top with the puff pastry and bake at 200 °C for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Imam bayildi with raisins
recipes.why: Sweet onions, tomato and raisins suit a soft, fruity red.
steps: Fry the aubergines in half the olive oil.
Cook the onion and garlic until soft, add the tomatoes and raisins and spoon over the aubergines.
Bake at 180 °C for 45 minutes and serve warm with parsley.

recipes.title: Roast squash with pomegranate molasses and feta
recipes.why: Sweet-sour pomegranate suits a juicy, light red.
steps: Roast the butternut squash with the olive oil at 200 °C for 35 minutes.
Drizzle with the pomegranate molasses and top with feta, pomegranate seeds and mint.

recipes.title: Cauliflower steaks with saffron and raisins
recipes.why: Saffron and golden raisins suit a round, aromatic white.
steps: Brush the cauliflower with the olive oil and saffron water and roast at 220 °C for 25 minutes.
Scatter with the golden raisins, pine nuts and capers.

recipes.title: Pea, mint and feta orzo with sumac
recipes.why: Fresh peas and tangy sumac suit a zesty, fruity white.
steps: Cook the orzo, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Toss with the lemon juice, olive oil, mint and crumbled feta.
Sprinkle with sumac.

recipes.title: Chilled soba with cucumber and shiso
recipes.why: Cool noodles and shiso suit a delicate, floral white.
steps: Cook the soba noodles and rinse in cold water.
Mix the light soy sauce, mirin and rice vinegar.
Toss with the cucumber and shiso leaves and scatter with toasted sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Carrot and apricot tagine with orange blossom
recipes.why: Orange blossom and apricot echo a floral, fruity white.
steps: Soften the onion with the cinnamon, add the carrots, chickpeas, dried apricots and water and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the orange blossom water and serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Sweet potato and black bean tacos with chipotle
recipes.why: Smoky, spicy tacos suit a peppery, oaked red.
steps: Roast the sweet potato with the chipotle in adobo and cumin seeds at 210 °C for 25 minutes.
Warm the black beans.
Fill the corn tortillas and serve with sour cream and lime.

recipes.title: Charred aubergine with tahini and smoked paprika
recipes.why: Smoky aubergine suits a structured, oaked red.
steps: Char the aubergines whole over a flame until collapsed, then scoop out the flesh.
Mix with the tahini, lemon juice and garlic.
Dust with smoked paprika, scatter with pomegranate seeds and serve with flatbread.

recipes.title: Skate with brown butter and sorrel
recipes.why: Sharp sorrel and nutty butter want a lean, high-acid white.
steps: Dust the skate wings with the plain flour and fry in half the butter for 3–4 minutes per side.
Brown the rest of the butter, add the capers and sorrel and spoon over.

recipes.title: Sea bream crudo with green apple and celery seed
recipes.why: Raw fish and crisp apple want a lean, mineral white.
steps: Slice the sea bream thinly and lay on cold plates.
Top with the green apple, lemon juice and olive oil and sprinkle with celery seeds.

recipes.title: Steamed cod with ginger and spring onion
recipes.why: Clean steamed fish suits a crisp, neutral white.
steps: Steam the cod loin with half the fresh ginger for 10 minutes.
Top with the rest of the ginger and the spring onions and pour over smoking sunflower oil and the light soy sauce.

recipes.title: Fish and chips with malt vinegar
recipes.why: Crisp batter and vinegar are a classic for sparkling wine.
steps: Fry the potatoes in the sunflower oil at 150 °C, then again at 190 °C.
Dip the cod loin in a batter of plain flour and sparkling water and fry for 6–7 minutes.
Serve with the peas and malt vinegar.

recipes.title: Salt cod fritters with nutmeg
recipes.why: Crisp, salty fritters suit a dry sparkling.
steps: Mix the salt cod, potatoes, eggs, parsley and nutmeg.
Shape into quenelles and fry in the sunflower oil at 180 °C until golden.

recipes.title: Halibut with elderflower beurre blanc
recipes.why: Elderflower in the butter sauce suits a floral, racy white.
steps: Reduce the shallot and dry white wine, then whisk in the butter and elderflower cordial.
Poach the halibut for 6–7 minutes and blanch the green asparagus.
Serve with the sauce.

recipes.title: Sea bass with pink grapefruit and fennel
recipes.why: Grapefruit and fennel suit a crisp, aromatic white.
steps: Toss the fennel with the grapefruit and half the olive oil.
Sear the sea bass skin-side down until crisp.
Serve on the salad with dill.

recipes.title: Monkfish skewers with lime and coriander seed
recipes.why: Lime and coriander seed suit a zesty, fruity white.
steps: Marinate the monkfish with the lime juice, coriander seeds, garlic and olive oil.
Thread onto skewers with the red pepper and grill for 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Ceviche with passion fruit leche de tigre and ají amarillo
recipes.why: Citrus-cured fish with chilli needs a crisp, fruity white.
steps: Blend the lime juice with the aji amarillo paste, the pulp of the passion fruit and a few fish trimmings into leche de tigre.
Pour over the diced sea bass and leave for 3 minutes.
Serve with the sweet potato, red onion, pink peppercorns and coriander leaves.

recipes.title: Arctic char with lentils and pumpkin seed oil
recipes.why: Toasty seed oil and earthy lentils suit a peppery white.
steps: Cook the puy lentils and dress with the white wine vinegar.
Sear the arctic char skin-side down.
Serve on the lentils, drizzled with the pumpkin seed oil and chives.

recipes.title: Salmon coulibiac with dill and smoked salt
recipes.why: Buttery pastry and salmon suit a round, oaked white.
steps: Mix the basmati rice with two chopped hard-boiled eggs, the dill, butter and smoked salt.
Layer with the salmon fillets on the puff pastry, wrap and brush with the last of the eggs, beaten.
Bake at 200 °C for 35–40 minutes.

recipes.title: Roast monkfish with pancetta and sage butter
recipes.why: Meaty monkfish and sage butter suit a rich, oaked white.
steps: Wrap the monkfish in the pancetta and roast with the potatoes at 200 °C for 15–18 minutes.
Foam the butter with the sage leaves and lemon juice and spoon over.

recipes.title: Sea bream baked with fennel and star anise
recipes.why: Gentle anise and fennel suit a round, aromatic white.
steps: Lay the sea bream on the sliced fennel with the star anise, dry white wine and olive oil.
Bake at 200 °C for 20–25 minutes and squeeze over the lemon.

recipes.title: Mackerel with rose harissa and chickpeas
recipes.why: Floral heat and oily fish suit a fresh, fruity rosé.
steps: Brush the mackerel fillets with the rose harissa and grill for 4 minutes.
Warm the chickpeas with the olive oil, lemon juice and parsley.
Serve together.

recipes.title: Thai steamed fish with lime, chilli and lemongrass
recipes.why: Lime, chilli and garlic want an off-dry, high-acid white.
steps: Stuff the sea bass with the lemongrass and steam for 12–15 minutes.
Mix the lime juice, red chilli, garlic, fish sauce and palm sugar and pour over the fish.

recipes.title: Fish curry with coconut and curry leaves
recipes.why: Curry leaves and coconut suit a perfumed white.
steps: Fry the curry leaves, onion and fresh ginger, add the ground turmeric and coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the cod loin and poach for 6 minutes. Serve with basmati rice.

recipes.title: Salmon with rhubarb and ginger
recipes.why: Tart rhubarb lifts salmon toward a light, juicy red.
steps: Roast the rhubarb with the fresh ginger and honey at 200 °C for 10 minutes.
Add the salmon fillets brushed with olive oil and roast for 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Tuna steak with lentils and juniper
recipes.why: Meaty tuna and earthy lentils suit a light red.
steps: Simmer the puy lentils with the shallot, red wine and juniper berries until tender.
Sear the tuna steaks in the olive oil for 1 minute per side.
Serve on the lentils.

recipes.title: Smoked mackerel kedgeree
recipes.why: Smoky fish and mild curry suit a crisp white with some oak.
steps: Soften the onion in the butter with the curry powder, add the basmati rice and cook in water until tender.
Fold in the smoked mackerel and top with the eggs and parsley.

recipes.title: Prawn and fennel risotto with pastis
recipes.why: Aniseed and sweet prawns suit a round, aromatic white.
steps: Soften the fennel in the butter, add the arborio rice and pastis.
Add the vegetable stock a ladle at a time for 18 minutes, adding the king prawns at the end.
Beat in the parmesan.

recipes.title: Parmesan frico with black pepper
recipes.why: Salty, crisp cheese wafers are made for a dry sparkling.
steps: Spoon small mounds of the parmesan onto a lined tray and flatten.
Grind over the black pepper and bake at 190 °C for 6–8 minutes until golden. Cool to crisp.

recipes.title: Crisps with crème fraîche, trout roe and yuzu
recipes.why: Salty crisps, roe and citrus are a classic for sparkling wine.
steps: Top each of the potato crisps with a little creme fraiche and trout roe.
Finish with the yuzu zest and chives.

recipes.title: Mini croque-monsieur with nutmeg béchamel
recipes.why: Toasted ham and cheese bites suit a dry sparkling.
steps: Make a thick béchamel with the butter, plain flour, milk and nutmeg.
Sandwich the sourdough bread with cooked ham and gruyere, top with béchamel and more cheese.
Bake at 220 °C for 10 minutes and cut into small squares.

recipes.title: Brown butter popcorn with crispy sage
recipes.why: Salty, buttery popcorn is a playful match for sparkling wine.
steps: Pop the popcorn kernels in the sunflower oil in a covered pan.
Brown the butter with the sage leaves until crisp.
Toss with the popcorn and flaky salt.

recipes.title: Fried stuffed olives with fennel seed
recipes.why: Crisp, salty olives are perfect with a dry sparkling.
steps: Mix the pork mince, parmesan and fennel seeds and stuff into the green olives.
Dip in the eggs, roll in breadcrumbs and fry in the sunflower oil at 180 °C until golden.

recipes.title: Pissaladière with anchovy and oregano
recipes.why: Sweet onion, anchovy and olive are a classic for a rosé.
steps: Cook the onion slowly in the olive oil for 40 minutes.
Spread over the pizza dough, top with anchovies, black olives and dried oregano.
Bake at 220 °C for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pan con tomate with jamón and smoked paprika
recipes.why: Tomato, ham and smoky paprika suit a dry rosé.
steps: Grill the sourdough bread and rub with the garlic.
Spoon over the grated tomatoes, drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with smoked paprika.
Top with the jamón.

recipes.title: Socca with rosemary and black pepper
recipes.why: Crisp chickpea pancake with herbs suits a fresh rosé.
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, water and half the olive oil and rest for 1 hour.
Pour into a very hot oiled pan, scatter with rosemary and bake at 250 °C for 10–12 minutes.
Grind over black pepper and cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Grilled pitta with tzatziki and sumac
recipes.why: Garlic yoghurt and tangy sumac suit a crisp rosé.
steps: Mix the greek yoghurt, cucumber and garlic into tzatziki.
Grill the pitta bread brushed with olive oil.
Sprinkle the tzatziki with sumac and serve.

recipes.title: Padrón peppers with yuzu salt
recipes.why: Blistered peppers and citrus salt suit a crisp, fruity white.
steps: Rub the yuzu zest into the flaky salt.
Blister the padron peppers in the olive oil over high heat.
Toss with the yuzu salt.

recipes.title: Boquerones with sherry vinegar and parsley
recipes.why: Vinegar-cured anchovies need a crisp, high-acid white.
steps: Cover the fresh anchovies with the sherry vinegar and chill for 6 hours.
Drain, cover with the olive oil, garlic and parsley.

recipes.title: Radishes with butter and fennel salt
recipes.why: Peppery radish and butter suit a lean, crisp white.
steps: Mix the fennel seeds with the flaky salt.
Serve the radishes with the butter and fennel salt for dipping.

recipes.title: Gilda skewers with anchovy, olive and guindilla
recipes.why: Briny, sharp pintxos want a lean, saline white.
steps: Thread an anchovy, a green olive and a guindilla pepper onto each skewer.
Drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.title: Liptauer spread with paprika and caraway
recipes.why: Spiced cheese spread suits a peppery Austrian white.
steps: Beat the quark with the butter, sweet paprika, caraway seeds and capers.
Spread on rye bread.

recipes.title: Devilled eggs with curry and chives
recipes.why: Creamy eggs with gentle spice suit a peppery white.
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, halve and remove the yolks.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise and curry powder and pipe back in.
Finish with chives.

recipes.title: Jamón croquetas with smoked paprika
recipes.why: Creamy croquetas suit a round, oaked white.
steps: Cook the butter and plain flour, whisk in the milk to a thick béchamel, add the jamón and smoked paprika and chill.
Shape, dip in the eggs and breadcrumbs and fry in the sunflower oil at 180 °C.

recipes.title: Mac and cheese bites with smoked cheddar
recipes.why: Creamy, smoky cheese suits a buttery, oaked white.
steps: Make a cheese sauce with the butter, plain flour, milk and smoked cheddar and mix with the cooked macaroni. Chill.
Cut into squares, coat in breadcrumbs and fry in the sunflower oil.

recipes.title: Prawn toast with toasted sesame
recipes.why: Crisp prawn toast suits a round, fresh white.
steps: Blitz the king prawns and spring onions to a paste and spread on the sourdough bread.
Press into the toasted sesame seeds and fry in the sunflower oil until golden.

recipes.title: Halloumi fries with za'atar and rose honey
recipes.why: Rose-scented honey and salty cheese suit a floral white.
steps: Dust the halloumi in the plain flour and fry in the sunflower oil until golden.
Drizzle with the honey mixed with rose water and sprinkle with zaatar.

recipes.title: Onion bhajis with nigella and mango chutney
recipes.why: Spiced fritters and sweet chutney suit an aromatic white.
steps: Mix the onion with the chickpea flour, nigella seeds, ground turmeric and a little water.
Fry spoonfuls in the sunflower oil at 180 °C.
Serve with the mango chutney.

recipes.title: Vegetable pakoras with tamarind chutney
recipes.why: Spiced batter and sweet-sour chutney suit a perfumed white.
steps: Mix the cauliflower and spinach with the chickpea flour, garam masala and water.
Fry spoonfuls in the sunflower oil.
Simmer the tamarind paste with the caster sugar for dipping.

recipes.title: Thai fish cakes with lime leaf and cucumber relish
recipes.why: Lime leaf and sweet-sour relish suit an off-dry white.
steps: Blitz the cod loin with the red curry paste and kaffir lime leaves, mix in the green beans and shape into cakes.
Fry in the sunflower oil.
Serve with the cucumber in the rice vinegar and caster sugar.

recipes.title: Pork gyoza with yuzu dipping sauce
recipes.why: Juicy dumplings and citrus suit an off-dry, high-acid white.
steps: Mix the pork mince, white cabbage and fresh ginger and fill the gyoza wrappers.
Fry in the sunflower oil until browned, add a splash of water, cover and steam for 3 minutes.
Serve with the light soy sauce mixed with the yuzu juice.

recipes.title: Beetroot hummus with dukkah
recipes.why: Earthy beetroot and toasted spice suit a light, juicy red.
steps: Blend the beetroot, chickpeas, tahini and lemon juice until smooth.
Sprinkle with dukkah and serve with flatbread.

recipes.title: Mushroom arancini with smoked scamorza
recipes.why: Earthy mushroom and smoky cheese suit a light, earthy red.
steps: Mix the arborio rice with the fried chestnut mushrooms.
Shape into balls around a cube of smoked scamorza, dip in eggs and breadcrumbs.
Fry in the sunflower oil at 180 °C.

recipes.title: Saffron arancini with ragù
recipes.why: Meaty filling and tomato suit a savoury red.
steps: Cook the arborio rice with the saffron and cool.
Cook the beef mince with the passata and peas into a thick ragù.
Shape the rice around the ragù, coat in eggs and breadcrumbs and fry in the sunflower oil.

recipes.title: Focaccia with cherry tomatoes and oregano
recipes.why: Tomato and oregano want a bright, high-acid Italian red.
steps: Press the pizza dough into an oiled tin and leave to rise.
Dimple with your fingers, top with the cherry tomatoes, olive oil, dried oregano and flaky salt.
Bake at 220 °C for 20–25 minutes.

recipes.title: Finocchiona with grissini
recipes.why: Fennel salami suits a spicy, fresh red.
steps: Wrap the finocchiona around the grissini.
Sprinkle with the toasted fennel seeds.

recipes.title: Lamb sausage rolls with ras el hanout
recipes.why: Spiced lamb in pastry suits a fruity, spicy red.
steps: Mix the lamb mince with the ras el hanout and roll inside the puff pastry.
Brush with eggs, sprinkle with nigella seeds and cut into pieces.
Bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Choripán with smoked paprika chimichurri
recipes.why: Grilled sausage and herbs are a natural for a red.
steps: Grill the chorizo and split lengthwise.
Mix the parsley, dried oregano, smoked paprika, red wine vinegar and olive oil.
Serve in the baguette with the chimichurri.

recipes.title: Bacon-wrapped prunes with almonds
recipes.why: Sweet prunes and smoky bacon match a jammy, ripe red.
steps: Stuff each of the prunes with an almond and wrap in smoked bacon.
Roast at 200 °C for 12–15 minutes.

recipes.title: Black pepper beef skewers
recipes.why: Peppery, charred beef suits a spicy, oaked red.
steps: Toss the sirloin steak with the black pepper, light soy sauce, garlic and olive oil.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 4–5 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherry-glazed meatballs
recipes.why: Black cherry glaze matches a ripe, oaked red.
steps: Mix the beef mince, breadcrumbs, eggs and smoked paprika into small meatballs and roast at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Warm the black cherry jam with the balsamic vinegar and toss the meatballs in it.

recipes.title: Chorizo in red wine with cloves
recipes.why: Smoky chorizo and wine suit a structured, oaked red.
steps: Brown the chorizo in a dry pan.
Add the red wine, cloves and bay leaves and simmer until syrupy.

recipes.title: Saucisson sec with fennel pollen and cornichons
recipes.why: Cured sausage suits a medium red with fresh acidity.
steps: Lay the saucisson sec on a board and dust with the fennel pollen.
Serve with cornichons and baguette.

recipes.title: Pork scratchings with sage and apple sauce
recipes.why: Crisp pork crackling and apple suit a supple, fresh red.
steps: Rub the pork rind with the sage and flaky salt.
Roast at 220 °C for 50–60 minutes until puffed and crisp.
Serve with the apples.

recipes.title: Lamb meatballs with violet mustard
recipes.why: Violet mustard brings out the floral side of a full Portuguese red.
steps: Mix the lamb mince, breadcrumbs and garlic into small meatballs and fry in the olive oil.
Serve with the violet mustard for dipping.

recipes.title: Venison sausage rolls with cranberry
recipes.why: Gamey sausage and tart cranberry suit an oaked red.
steps: Mix the venison sausages with the cranberries and thyme and roll inside the puff pastry.
Brush with eggs, cut into pieces and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Crottin de Chavignol with celery and celery salt
recipes.why: Tangy goat's cheese is the classic for a lean white.
steps: Slice the crottin de chavignol.
Serve with the celery, sourdough bread and a pinch of celery seeds.

recipes.title: Goat's cheese with grilled apricots and thyme
recipes.why: Juicy apricot and tangy cheese suit a fruity, crisp white.
steps: Grill the apricots cut-side down, drizzle with honey and thyme.
Serve warm with the goat's cheese.

recipes.title: Fresh goat's cheese with green apple and lemon verbena
recipes.why: Lemon verbena and apple suit a floral, racy white.
steps: Spread the goat's cheese on a plate.
Top with the green apple, lemon verbena and olive oil.

recipes.title: Comté with toasted hazelnuts and smoked salt
recipes.why: Nutty Comté and toasted hazelnut suit a round, oaked white.
steps: Toast the hazelnuts and toss with the smoked salt.
Serve with shards of the comte.

recipes.title: Gruyère with quince and fennel seed
recipes.why: Nutty Alpine cheese and quince suit a round, fresh white.
steps: Slice the gruyere and quince paste.
Sprinkle the cheese with the fennel seeds and serve with oat crackers.

recipes.title: Baked Vacherin Mont d'Or with smoked garlic
recipes.why: Molten, creamy cheese suits a rich, oaked white.
steps: Push the smoked garlic into the vacherin mont d'or and pour over the dry white wine.
Bake in its box at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Serve with the potatoes and cornichons for dipping.

recipes.title: Raclette with potatoes and white pepper
recipes.why: Melted Alpine cheese suits a round, fresh white.
steps: Melt the raclette cheese under a grill.
Scrape over the potatoes and season with white pepper.
Serve with cornichons.

recipes.title: Munster with cumin and warm potatoes
recipes.why: Pungent Munster and cumin are the classic for an aromatic white.
steps: Serve the munster at room temperature, sprinkled with the cumin seeds.
Serve with the warm potatoes.

recipes.title: Époisses with gingerbread
recipes.why: Rich washed-rind cheese and spiced gingerbread suit an aromatic white.
steps: Serve the epoisses at room temperature with the toasted gingerbread.

recipes.title: Taleggio with crystallised ginger and walnuts
recipes.why: Ginger and creamy washed-rind cheese suit a perfumed white.
steps: Serve the taleggio with the crystallised ginger and walnuts.

recipes.title: Baked Camembert with apricot and rosemary
recipes.why: Creamy cheese and sweet apricot suit an off-dry white.
steps: Score the camembert, push in the rosemary and bake at 200 °C for 15–20 minutes.
Warm the dried apricots with the honey and spoon over.
Serve with baguette.

recipes.title: Aged Manchego with membrillo and black pepper
recipes.why: Firm aged sheep's cheese stands up to a big, tannic red.
steps: Cut the manchego into wedges and grind over the black pepper.
Serve with the quince paste and oat crackers.

recipes.title: Parmigiano with aged balsamic
recipes.why: Crystalline Parmigiano needs a firm, savoury red.
steps: Break the parmesan into chunks.
Drizzle with a few drops of the balsamic vinegar.

recipes.title: Mature cheddar with fig chutney and celery
recipes.why: Sharp cheddar and sweet chutney suit a full, spicy red.
steps: Serve the mature cheddar with the fig chutney, celery and oat crackers.

recipes.title: Aged Mimolette with walnuts and coffee
recipes.why: Nutty aged cheese and coffee echo the toast of a red.
steps: Toss the walnuts with the honey and ground coffee.
Serve with the mimolette.

recipes.title: Idiazabal with quince and smoked almonds
recipes.why: Smoked sheep's cheese suits a structured, oaked red.
steps: Slice the idiazabal and quince paste.
Serve with the smoked almonds.

recipes.title: Aged provolone with black cherry jam
recipes.why: Sharp provolone and dark cherry match a ripe, plush red.
steps: Cut the provolone into chunks.
Serve with the black cherry jam and grissini.

recipes.title: Pecorino with fresh figs and fennel
recipes.why: Salty sheep's cheese and ripe figs suit a fruity Italian red.
steps: Serve the pecorino with the fresh figs and fennel.
Drizzle the figs with honey.

recipes.title: Pecorino Toscano with chestnut honey and walnuts
recipes.why: Bitter-sweet chestnut honey and pecorino suit a savoury red.
steps: Slice the pecorino and drizzle with the chestnut honey.
Scatter with walnuts.

recipes.title: Grilled smoked scamorza with oregano and chilli
recipes.why: Smoky, melting cheese suits a spicy, oaked red.
steps: Grill the smoked scamorza in a hot pan until browned on both sides.
Sprinkle with the dried oregano, chilli flakes and olive oil and serve with sourdough bread.

recipes.title: Serra da Estrela with violet mustard
recipes.why: Creamy sheep's cheese and violet mustard suit a perfumed Dão red.
steps: Cut the top off the serra da estrela and spoon out the soft cheese.
Serve with the violet mustard and sourdough bread.

recipes.title: Castelmagno with honey and dried rose
recipes.why: Crumbly aged cheese and rose meet the grip and perfume of a firm red.
steps: Crumble the castelmagno onto a plate.
Drizzle with honey and scatter with dried rose petals and walnuts.

recipes.title: Baked feta with tomatoes and oregano
recipes.why: Salty feta and sweet tomatoes suit a fresh, fruity rosé.
steps: Put the feta in a dish surrounded by the cherry tomatoes.
Sprinkle with the dried oregano and chilli flakes, drizzle with olive oil and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Labneh with za'atar and olive oil
recipes.why: Tangy labneh and herbs suit a crisp, dry rosé.
steps: Spread the labneh on a plate.
Drizzle with the olive oil, sprinkle with the zaatar and serve with flatbread.

recipes.title: Fresh ricotta with roasted plums and thyme
recipes.why: Roasted plums and creamy ricotta suit a light, fruity red.
steps: Roast the plums with the thyme and honey at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Serve warm with the ricotta.

recipes.title: Roquefort with honeycomb and walnuts
recipes.why: Salty blue cheese and honey are the classic for a sweet white.
steps: Serve the roquefort with the honeycomb, walnuts and oat crackers.

recipes.title: Stilton with crystallised ginger
recipes.why: Stilton and ginger suit a rich, sweet fortified wine.
steps: Serve the stilton with the crystallised ginger and oat crackers.

recipes.title: Stilton with walnuts and port-soaked figs
recipes.why: Figs soaked in fortified wine build a bridge to a sweet, fortified red.
steps: Soak the dried figs in the port for 2 hours.
Serve with the stilton and walnuts.

recipes.title: Gorgonzola dolce with apricots and lemon zest
recipes.why: Creamy blue and apricot suit a sweet wine with bright acidity.
steps: Serve the gorgonzola with the dried apricots, sprinkled with lemon zest.
Add the oat crackers.

recipes.title: Valdeón with dates and orange zest
recipes.why: Strong blue cheese and dates match a dense, sweet fortified wine.
steps: Serve the valdeon with the medjool dates, sprinkled with orange zest.

recipes.title: Fourme d'Ambert with peaches and lavender
recipes.why: Mild blue and lavender-scented peach suit a sweet, floral sparkling wine.
steps: Warm the honey with the dried lavender.
Serve the fourme d'ambert with the peaches drizzled with lavender honey.

recipes.title: Cambozola with grapes and celery
recipes.why: Mild, creamy blue and grapes suit an off-dry white.
steps: Serve the cambozola with the white grapes and celery.

recipes.title: Brie with cranberries and thyme
recipes.why: Soft brie and tart cranberry suit a light red.
steps: Simmer the cranberries with the caster sugar and thyme for 8 minutes.
Serve with the brie and baguette.

recipes.title: Tartiflette with speck and Reblochon
recipes.why: Melted Reblochon and potatoes suit a rich, oaked white.
steps: Fry the speck with the onion.
Layer with the potatoes and double cream in a dish and lay the reblochon on top, rind up.
Bake at 200 °C for 25–30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese fondue with mace
recipes.why: Melted Alpine cheese and a crisp sparkling wine cut through the richness.
steps: Rub the pot with the garlic and heat the dry white wine.
Melt in the gruyere and emmental tossed with the cornflour, stirring.
Season with the ground mace and serve with the baguette for dipping.

recipes.title: Mozzarella in carrozza with lemon thyme
recipes.why: Crisp, fried cheese sandwiches suit a round, fresh white.
steps: Sandwich the mozzarella and lemon thyme between the sourdough bread.
Dip in the eggs beaten with the milk and fry in the sunflower oil until golden.

recipes.title: Smoked provola with roasted grapes
recipes.why: Smoky cheese and sweet grapes suit a soft, fruity red.
steps: Roast the red grapes with the olive oil and rosemary at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Serve warm with the smoked provola.

recipes.title: Pecorino with chilli honey
recipes.why: Sweet heat and salty cheese suit a ripe red with a touch of sweetness.
steps: Warm the honey with the chilli flakes.
Drizzle over the pecorino.

recipes.title: Chocolate fondant with cherries and star anise
recipes.why: Molten chocolate needs a sweet, rich fortified wine; star anise follows its spice.
steps: Melt the dark chocolate and butter with the star anise.
Whisk the eggs and caster sugar until pale, fold in the chocolate and plain flour.
Bake in buttered moulds at 200 °C for 10–12 minutes and serve with the sour cherries.

recipes.title: Flourless chocolate cake with espresso
recipes.why: Dense chocolate and coffee suit a sweet, powerful fortified red.
steps: Melt the dark chocolate and butter with the ground coffee espresso.
Whisk the eggs and caster sugar until thick and fold in.
Bake at 170 °C for 35–40 minutes and dust with cocoa powder.

recipes.title: Black Forest trifle with cardamom cream
recipes.why: Cherry and chocolate suit a ruby fortified wine; cardamom lifts the cream.
steps: Whip the double cream with the caster sugar and cardamom.
Layer the chocolate sponge, black cherry jam and cream in glasses.
Finish with grated dark chocolate.

recipes.title: Plum crumble with ground ginger
recipes.why: Baked plums and warm ginger suit a sweet, fruity fortified wine.
steps: Toss the plums with the caster sugar and ground ginger in a dish.
Rub the butter into the plain flour and light brown sugar and scatter over.
Bake at 190 °C for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate and chestnut torte with clove
recipes.why: Earthy chestnut and chocolate suit a rich, sweet fortified wine.
steps: Melt the dark chocolate and butter, beat in the chestnut puree, chestnut honey, cloves and egg yolks.
Whisk the egg whites with the caster sugar and fold in.
Bake at 170 °C for 35–40 minutes.

recipes.title: Fig and walnut tart with port glaze
recipes.why: The fortified wine in the glaze echoes the one in the glass.
steps: Line a tin with the shortcrust pastry.
Beat the walnuts, butter, caster sugar and eggs and spread in the case. Top with the fresh figs.
Bake at 180 °C for 35–40 minutes and brush with the port syrup.

recipes.title: Mince pies with allspice
recipes.why: Dried fruit and warm spice are the classic for a tawny fortified wine.
steps: Mix the mincemeat with the allspice and orange zest.
Line tart tins with the shortcrust pastry, fill and top with pastry stars.
Bake at 200 °C for 18–20 minutes and dust with icing sugar.

recipes.title: Chocolate mousse with smoked salt
recipes.why: Smoky salt and dark chocolate suit a sweet, powerful fortified wine.
steps: Melt the dark chocolate with the double cream and smoked salt, then beat in the egg yolks.
Whisk the egg whites with the caster sugar and fold in.
Chill for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Cherry frangipane tart with tonka bean
recipes.why: Tonka's vanilla-almond warmth and cherry suit a sweet fortified wine.
steps: Line a tin with the shortcrust pastry.
Beat the ground almonds, butter, caster sugar, eggs and tonka bean, spread in the case and press in the sour cherries.
Bake at 180 °C for 35–40 minutes.

recipes.title: Red wine poached pears with cinnamon and chocolate
recipes.why: Wine-poached pears and chocolate suit a ruby fortified wine.
steps: Poach the pear in the red wine, caster sugar and cinnamon for 30–40 minutes.
Reduce the liquid to a syrup.
Serve with the syrup and a drizzle of dark chocolate.

recipes.title: Cherry brownies with cocoa nibs
recipes.why: Fudgy chocolate and cherry suit a rich, sweet fortified wine.
steps: Melt the dark chocolate and butter, beat in the caster sugar and eggs, then the plain flour.
Fold in the dried sour cherries and cocoa nibs.
Bake at 180 °C for 22–25 minutes.

recipes.title: Blackcurrant and liquorice pavlova
recipes.why: Blackcurrant and liquorice suit a dark, sweet fortified red.
steps: Whisk the egg whites with the caster sugar into a stiff meringue and bake at 120 °C for 90 minutes.
Cook the blackcurrants with a little sugar and the liquorice powder.
Top with whipped double cream and the blackcurrants.

recipes.title: Lemon tart with lemon verbena
recipes.why: Sharp lemon needs a sweet wine with matching acidity; verbena adds perfume.
steps: Blind-bake the shortcrust pastry.
Infuse the double cream with the lemon verbena, strain and whisk with the lemon, eggs and caster sugar.
Pour into the case and bake at 150 °C for 30 minutes until just set.

recipes.title: Passion fruit soufflé
recipes.why: Tart passion fruit wants a sweet, high-acid late-harvest wine.
steps: Cook the passion fruit juice with the cornflour and half the caster sugar until thick, then beat in the egg yolks.
Whisk the egg whites with the rest of the sugar and fold in.
Spoon into buttered ramekins and bake at 200 °C for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Lime and coconut posset with lemongrass
recipes.why: Lime and lemongrass need a sweet wine with bright acidity.
steps: Simmer the double cream, coconut milk, caster sugar and lemongrass for 3 minutes, then remove the lemongrass.
Stir in the lime juice and zest, pour into glasses and chill for 3 hours.
Top with toasted coconut.

recipes.title: Mango and lime leaf sorbet
recipes.why: Tropical mango and lime leaf suit a sweet, racy white.
steps: Simmer the caster sugar and water with the kaffir lime leaves and cool.
Blend with the mango and lime juice and churn.

recipes.title: Key lime pie with ginger biscuit base
recipes.why: Tangy lime and ginger suit a sweet wine with lively acidity.
steps: Mix the ginger biscuits with the butter and ground ginger and press into a tin.
Whisk the condensed milk, egg yolks and lime and pour in.
Bake at 160 °C for 15 minutes and chill.

recipes.title: Roasted pineapple with rum and star anise
recipes.why: Caramelised pineapple and star anise suit a sweet, high-acid wine.
steps: Toss the pineapple with the light brown sugar, dark rum, star anise and butter.
Roast at 220 °C for 20–25 minutes, basting.

recipes.title: Yuzu cheesecake
recipes.why: Yuzu's sharp perfume suits a sweet wine with bright acidity.
steps: Mix the digestive biscuits with the melted butter and press into a tin.
Beat the cream cheese, caster sugar, eggs and yuzu juice and pour over.
Bake at 150 °C for 50 minutes and chill.

recipes.title: Rhubarb fool with rose
recipes.why: Tart rhubarb and rose suit a sweet, high-acid white.
steps: Cook the rhubarb with the caster sugar until soft and cool.
Whip the double cream with the rose water and ripple through the rhubarb.

recipes.title: Blood orange granita with tarragon
recipes.why: Bright blood orange needs a sweet wine with acidity; tarragon adds lift.
steps: Warm the caster sugar with a little blood orange juice and the tarragon, then strain into the rest of the juice.
Freeze in a tray, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Gooseberry and elderflower crumble
recipes.why: Tart gooseberries and elderflower suit a sweet, racy white.
steps: Toss the gooseberries with the caster sugar and elderflower cordial.
Rub the butter into the plain flour, scatter over with the flaked almonds.
Bake at 190 °C for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon posset with candied fennel seed
recipes.why: Sharp lemon and fennel suit a sweet wine with high acidity.
steps: Boil the double cream and caster sugar for 3 minutes, stir in the lemon and chill for 3 hours.
Sprinkle with the candied fennel seeds.

recipes.title: Raspberry and lime pavlova with sumac
recipes.why: Tart raspberries and sumac need a sweet, racy wine.
steps: Whisk the egg whites with the caster sugar into a meringue and bake at 120 °C for 90 minutes.
Top with whipped double cream, raspberries, lime zest and sumac.

recipes.title: Crème brûlée with cardamom
recipes.why: Rich custard and caramel are the classic for a sweet white; cardamom adds lift.
steps: Infuse the double cream with the cardamom, strain and whisk into the egg yolks and half the caster sugar.
Bake in ramekins in a water bath at 150 °C for 35–40 minutes and chill.
Sprinkle with the rest of the sugar and caramelise with a blowtorch.

recipes.title: Pear tarte tatin with ginger
recipes.why: Caramelised pear and ginger suit a sweet, golden white.
steps: Make a caramel with the caster sugar and butter, add the fresh ginger and pear and cook for 10 minutes.
Cover with the puff pastry and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Turn out to serve.

recipes.title: Roast apricots with honey and vanilla
recipes.why: Honeyed apricots echo the flavours of a sweet white.
steps: Lay the apricots in a dish with the honey, vanilla pod and butter.
Roast at 200 °C for 15–20 minutes and serve with greek yoghurt.

recipes.title: Pain perdu with caramelised apples and cinnamon
recipes.why: Caramel, apple and brioche suit a rich, sweet white.
steps: Caramelise the apples in half the butter and caster sugar with the cinnamon.
Soak the brioche in the eggs and milk and fry in the rest of the butter.
Serve with the apples.

recipes.title: Quince poached in honey with star anise
recipes.why: Fragrant quince and honey suit a sweet, golden wine.
steps: Simmer the quince with the honey, water, star anise and lemon for 1½ hours until rosy.
Serve with the syrup.

recipes.title: Crema catalana with rosemary
recipes.why: Burnt-sugar custard suits a sweet white; rosemary adds a savoury lift.
steps: Infuse the milk with the lemon zest and rosemary, strain.
Whisk the egg yolks, half the caster sugar and cornflour, add the milk and cook until thick.
Chill, then sprinkle with the rest of the sugar and caramelise.

recipes.title: Pastéis de nata with nutmeg
recipes.why: Caramelised custard tarts suit a sweet, golden wine.
steps: Cook the milk, caster sugar, plain flour and egg yolks into a custard with the nutmeg.
Line muffin tins with rolled puff pastry and fill.
Bake at the highest oven setting for 12–15 minutes until blistered.

recipes.title: Salted caramel apple tart with smoked salt
recipes.why: Smoky caramel and apple suit a rich, botrytised white.
steps: Make a caramel with the caster sugar, butter and double cream and add the smoked salt.
Line a tin with the shortcrust pastry, fan in the apples and brush with caramel.
Bake at 190 °C for 35–40 minutes.

recipes.title: Bread and butter pudding with apricot jam and vanilla
recipes.why: Custard and apricot suit a sweet, honeyed wine.
steps: Spread the brioche with butter and apricot jam and layer in a dish.
Whisk the milk, double cream, eggs, caster sugar and vanilla pod seeds and pour over.
Bake at 170 °C for 35–40 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice pudding with golden raisins and cinnamon
recipes.why: Creamy rice and raisins suit a sweet, golden white.
steps: Mix the pudding rice, milk, caster sugar, golden raisins and cinnamon in a dish, dot with butter.
Bake at 150 °C for 1½ hours, stirring once.

recipes.title: Honey and almond cake with orange blossom
recipes.why: Honeyed almond cake suits a sweet, golden white.
steps: Beat the butter and honey, then the eggs, ground almonds and orange zest.
Bake at 170 °C for 35–40 minutes.
Brush with honey mixed with the orange blossom water.

recipes.title: Baked figs with mascarpone and chestnut honey
recipes.why: Jammy figs and honey suit a sweet, golden wine.
steps: Drizzle the fresh figs with the chestnut honey and roast at 200 °C for 12–15 minutes.
Serve with mascarpone and walnuts.

recipes.title: Peach melba with rose
recipes.why: Peach and rose echo the floral sweetness of sparkling wine.
steps: Poach the white peaches in a light syrup of the caster sugar and water, then peel.
Blend the raspberries with the rose water.
Serve the peaches with vanilla ice cream and the raspberry sauce.

recipes.title: Strawberries with lavender sabayon
recipes.why: Lavender and strawberry suit a floral, sweet sparkling wine.
steps: Whisk the egg yolks, caster sugar, dry white wine and dried lavender over simmering water until thick.
Spoon over the strawberries.

recipes.title: Apricot and orange blossom galette
recipes.why: Apricot and orange blossom echo the perfume of a sweet white.
steps: Roll out the shortcrust pastry and scatter with the ground almonds.
Toss the apricots with the caster sugar and orange blossom water, pile in the centre and fold up the edges.
Bake at 200 °C for 30–35 minutes.

recipes.title: Lychee and rose panna cotta
recipes.why: Lychee and rose reach the floral perfume of sparkling wine.
steps: Warm the double cream, milk and caster sugar, dissolve the gelatine and add the rose water.
Set in moulds for 4 hours.
Serve with the lychees.

recipes.title: Jasmine tea panna cotta with peaches
recipes.why: Jasmine and peach suit a floral, sweet sparkling wine.
steps: Infuse the double cream with the jasmine tea and caster sugar, strain and dissolve the gelatine.
Set in moulds for 4 hours.
Serve with sliced peaches.

recipes.title: White peach and lemon verbena granita
recipes.why: Peach and verbena suit a light, floral sparkling wine.
steps: Simmer the caster sugar and water with the lemon verbena and cool.
Blend with the white peaches and lemon juice and freeze, scraping every 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Melon with honey and lemon balm
recipes.why: Sweet melon and lemon balm suit a floral sparkling wine.
steps: Cut the cantaloupe melon into slices.
Drizzle with the honey and lime juice and scatter with lemon balm.

recipes.title: Pear and chamomile tart
recipes.why: Chamomile and pear suit a floral, sweet sparkling wine.
steps: Infuse the double cream with the chamomile and strain.
Line a tin with the shortcrust pastry, lay in the pear and pour over the cream whisked with the eggs and caster sugar.
Bake at 180 °C for 35–40 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange blossom madeleines
recipes.why: Light, floral madeleines suit a sweet sparkling wine.
steps: Whisk the eggs, caster sugar and honey, fold in the plain flour, butter and orange blossom water and rest for 1 hour.
Bake in madeleine moulds at 200 °C for 9–10 minutes.

recipes.title: Raspberry and rose Eton mess
recipes.why: Rose and raspberry suit a floral, sweet sparkling wine.
steps: Whip the double cream with the rose water.
Fold in the meringues and raspberries.
Scatter with pistachios.

recipes.title: Vanilla ice cream with PX-soaked raisins and cinnamon
recipes.why: A classic Andalusian dessert, built for a dense, sweet fortified wine.
steps: Soak the raisins in the sweet sherry with the cinnamon overnight.
Spoon over the vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Sticky toffee pudding with dates
recipes.why: Dates and toffee mirror the dried-fruit richness of PX.
steps: Soak the medjool dates in boiling water, then blend.
Beat with half the butter, half the light brown sugar, the eggs and plain flour and bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes.
Make a toffee sauce with the rest of the butter, sugar and the double cream and pour over.

recipes.title: Coffee and walnut cake
recipes.why: Coffee and walnut suit a dense, sweet fortified wine.
steps: Beat the butter and caster sugar, then the eggs, plain flour, walnuts and half the coffee.
Bake at 180 °C for 25–30 minutes.
Ice with the icing sugar mixed with the rest of the coffee.

recipes.title: Chocolate and hazelnut tart with tonka bean
recipes.why: Rich chocolate and toasted nuts suit a dense, sweet fortified wine.
steps: Blind-bake the shortcrust pastry.
Melt the dark chocolate with the double cream, beat in the eggs and pour into the case with the hazelnuts.
Bake at 160 °C for 20 minutes and grate over the tonka bean.

recipes.title: Spiced fig and date loaf with allspice
recipes.why: Dried fruit and spice echo the raisiny depth of PX.
steps: Soak the dried figs and medjool dates in the black tea overnight.
Mix in the light brown sugar, plain flour, eggs and allspice.
Bake in a loaf tin at 160 °C for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Turrón semifreddo with cinnamon
recipes.why: Honeyed nougat and cinnamon suit a sweet, dense fortified wine.
steps: Whisk the egg yolks and caster sugar until pale, fold in the whipped double cream, turron and cinnamon.
Freeze in a loaf tin for 6 hours.

recipes.title: Pecan pie with molasses
recipes.why: Molasses and toasted pecans match the dark richness of PX.
steps: Line a tin with the shortcrust pastry and fill with the pecans.
Whisk the molasses, light brown sugar, butter and eggs and pour over.
Bake at 170 °C for 45–50 minutes.

recipes.title: Tiramisu with Marsala and cardamom
recipes.why: Coffee, cocoa and mascarpone suit a dense, sweet fortified wine.
steps: Beat the egg yolks with the caster sugar, cardamom and mascarpone, fold in the whisked egg whites.
Dip the savoiardi in the coffee and marsala and layer with the cream.
Chill overnight and dust with cocoa powder.

recipes.title: Apple strudel with raisins and cinnamon
recipes.why: Apple and cinnamon suit an off-dry white with bright acidity.
steps: Mix the apples, raisins, caster sugar and cinnamon.
Layer the filo pastry with butter and breadcrumbs, spread the filling and roll up.
Bake at 190 °C for 35–40 minutes.

recipes.title: Green apple and lime sorbet
recipes.why: Crisp apple and lime mirror an off-dry white.
steps: Make a syrup with the caster sugar and water.
Blend with the green apple and lime juice and churn.

recipes.title: Plum Kuchen with cardamom
recipes.why: Tart plums and cardamom suit an off-dry, fruity white.
steps: Beat the butter and caster sugar, then the eggs, plain flour and cardamom.
Spread in a tin and press in the plums.
Bake at 180 °C for 35–40 minutes.

recipes.title: Rhubarb and ginger crumble
recipes.why: Tart rhubarb and ginger suit an off-dry white.
steps: Toss the rhubarb with the caster sugar and fresh ginger.
Rub the butter into the plain flour and oats and scatter over.
Bake at 190 °C for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pear and elderflower jelly
recipes.why: Pear and elderflower echo a floral, off-dry white.
steps: Warm a little of the pear juice and dissolve the gelatine.
Mix with the rest of the juice and the elderflower cordial, add the pear and set for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Apricot dumplings with buttered crumbs and vanilla
recipes.why: Apricot and vanilla suit an off-dry white.
steps: Mix the quark, plain flour and eggs into a dough and wrap around the apricots.
Simmer for 12 minutes.
Roll in the breadcrumbs fried in the butter with the vanilla pod seeds and dust with caster sugar.

recipes.title: Lemon drizzle cake with lemongrass
recipes.why: Zesty lemon and lemongrass suit an off-dry, racy white.
steps: Beat the butter and caster sugar, then the eggs, plain flour, lemon zest and lemongrass.
Bake at 180 °C for 35–40 minutes.
Pour over the lemon juice mixed with sugar while warm.

recipes.title: Peach and passion fruit pavlova with lime leaf
recipes.why: Juicy peach and tart passion fruit suit an off-dry white.
steps: Whisk the egg whites with the caster sugar into a meringue and bake at 120 °C for 90 minutes.
Top with whipped double cream, sliced peaches, passion fruit pulp and the kaffir lime leaves.

recipes.title: Chocolate and cherry tart with ancho chilli
recipes.why: Chocolate, cherry and mild chilli suit a rich red with a touch of sweetness.
steps: Blind-bake the shortcrust pastry.
Melt the dark chocolate with the double cream and ancho chilli and pour in over the sour cherries.
Chill until set.

recipes.title: Black cherry and chocolate pots
recipes.why: Black cherry and chocolate match a ripe, sweetish red.
steps: Spoon the black cherry jam into small glasses.
Melt the dark chocolate with the double cream, beat in the eggs and pour over.
Chill for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Dark chocolate truffles with rosemary
recipes.why: Bitter chocolate and rosemary suit a ripe red with gentle sweetness.
steps: Infuse the double cream with the rosemary, strain and pour over the dark chocolate.
Chill, roll into balls and coat in cocoa powder.

recipes.title: Mexican chocolate cake with cinnamon
recipes.why: Chocolate and cinnamon suit a rich, slightly sweet red.
steps: Melt the dark chocolate and butter, beat in the caster sugar and eggs.
Fold in the plain flour and cinnamon and bake at 180 °C for 30–35 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberries with balsamic and black pepper
recipes.why: Strawberries and a touch of pepper suit a sweet, sparkling wine.
steps: Toss the strawberries with the balsamic vinegar, caster sugar and black pepper and leave for 15 minutes.
Serve with mascarpone.

recipes.title: Gooseberry fool with rosemary
recipes.why: Tart gooseberries and cream suit a sweet sparkling wine.
steps: Cook the gooseberries with the caster sugar and rosemary until soft, remove the rosemary and cool.
Fold into the whipped double cream.

recipes.title: Apple tarte fine with lemon thyme
recipes.why: A thin apple tart suits a sweet, racy white.
steps: Lay the apples over the puff pastry, brush with butter and sprinkle with caster sugar and lemon thyme.
Bake at 200 °C for 20–25 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry and rhubarb galette with cardamom
recipes.why: Red fruit and cardamom suit a sweet, fruity wine.
steps: Toss the strawberries and rhubarb with the caster sugar and cardamom.
Pile onto the rolled shortcrust pastry and fold up the edges.
Bake at 200 °C for 30–35 minutes.

recipes.title: Lychee and crystallised ginger sorbet
recipes.why: Lychee and ginger echo the perfume and spice of an aromatic white.
steps: Blend the lychees with the caster sugar and lime juice and churn.
Fold in the crystallised ginger.

recipes.title: Rose and pistachio baklava
recipes.why: Rose syrup and pistachio suit an aromatic, sweet white.
steps: Layer the filo pastry with butter and pistachios in a tin and cut into diamonds.
Bake at 180 °C for 40 minutes.
Pour over a syrup of the caster sugar, water and rose water.

recipes.title: Mango panna cotta with cardamom
recipes.why: Mango and cardamom suit a perfumed, sweet white.
steps: Warm the double cream, caster sugar and cardamom and dissolve the gelatine.
Stir in the mango and set for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Cherry clafoutis with star anise
recipes.why: Baked cherries suit a sweet, red-fruited wine; star anise adds spice.
steps: Lay the sour cherries in a buttered dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, plain flour, caster sugar and star anise and pour over.
Bake at 180 °C for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Summer pudding with blackcurrants
recipes.why: Tart red and black fruit suits a sweet, fruity wine.
steps: Cook the blackcurrants and raspberries with the caster sugar for 3 minutes.
Line a bowl with the white bread, fill with the fruit and cover with bread.
Weigh down and chill overnight.

recipes.title: Blackberry and apple crumble with allspice
recipes.why: Blackberry and warm spice suit a sweet, fruity wine.
steps: Toss the blackberries and apples with the caster sugar and allspice.
Rub the butter into the plain flour and scatter over.
Bake at 190 °C for 35 minutes.
